title: Online AC1024 samples and BLOCK_HEADER relative soft-pointer fix
scope: Locate candidate files for a second independent AC1024 input profile without admitting any file as a fixture or evidence before inspecting its bytes and provenance.

sources.title: Autodesk AutoCAD LT Sample Files
sources.evidence: Autodesk lists sample DWGs and says the sample set applies to AutoCAD LT 2010 and later.
sources.limitation: The page does not identify the saved DWG format version for each individual download.

sources.title: AutoCAD 2010 sample-file list and archive pointer
sources.evidence: The 2009 post identifies the listed files as AutoCAD 2010 samples and points to Autodesk's sample archive.
sources.limitation: Secondary historical source; it does not provide file hashes or verify that current archive bytes are unchanged.

downloadAudit.otherEndpoints: Several newer sample filenames listed on the LT archive returned HTTP 403; no bytes were retained for them.

independentWireEvidence.normativeSource: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1 §2.13: raw handle codes 0x6/0x8/0xA/0xC encode relative soft-pointer references; code 0x8 resolves to base handle minus one.

peer.name: LibreDWG
peer.jsonObservation: BLOCK_HEADER handle [0,1,2] has ownerhandle [8,0,0,1]; BLOCK_CONTROL handle is [0,1,1].

implementation.behavior: BLOCK_HEADER role validation now accepts DWG relative handle encodings 0x6, 0x8, 0xA and 0xC when the expected semantic role is soft pointer. It still rejects wrong semantic roles and canonical null is accepted only for a null reference.

sampleRead.result: PASS: current libdxfrw reports operationSucceeded=true and legacyError=0, publishes all 498/498 observed frames, and has zero entity/object parse failures. Strict DXF output remains refused because the source read disposition is not qualified for strict-complete export.
sampleRead.preFixDiagnostic: BLOCK_HEADER body handle role mismatch for blockControl: raw code 8 target 1

implementation.generatedControl: PASS: libdxfrw_block_record_body_handle_roles covers all four ODA relative soft-pointer encodings and the existing wrong-role, truncation/reset and corrected-retry cases.

qualificationGate: Download only to a scratch location and record URL, retrieval date, byte length and SHA-256.
Verify the first six bytes are AC1024 before treating a file as an AC1024 sample.
Check hashes against the existing local corpus so aliases do not count as independent sources.
Run current fast read/strict-output probes and independent reader comparison on eligible candidates.
Do not commit downloaded DWG or derived DXF fixtures; create a local-from-scratch fixture only if a minimized regression is needed.
result: Autodesk's title_block-ansi sample is a new unique AC1024 source. It exposed a real BLOCK_HEADER false rejection caused by treating a relative soft-pointer wire code as a different semantic role. The bounded parser fix is covered by a generated fast test and the entire sample now reads with 498/498 frames published and no entity/object parse failures. Other retrieved samples either match existing AC1024 hashes or are AC1021. No drawing fixture was added to the repository.
